scope: PQ character-facing reverse navigation and canonical page/index identity resolution

aliases.policy: Aliases are presentation/source-name metadata only; canonical relationship targets remain unchanged.

evidence_boundary: Character relationships are limited to explicit objective/Ultimate Finish references already present in the canonical relationship layer.
Roster appearance, generic enemy references, and inferred participation are not converted into character relationships.
The five documented aliases remain source/display mappings and do not create duplicate character identities.
The character record layer currently exposes canonical names rather than stable character IDs; this batch therefore uses exact canonical names for navigation and does not invent IDs.
